title: Learning Where the Physics Is: Probabilistic Adaptive Sampling for Stiff PDEs
summary: Modeling stiff partial differential equations (PDEs) with sharp gradients remains a significant challenge for scientific machine learning. While Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs) struggle with spectral bias and slow training times, Physics-Informed Extreme Learning Machines (PIELMs) offer a rapid, closed-form linear solution but are fundamentally limited by physics-agnostic, random initialization. We introduce the Gaussian Mixture Model Adaptive PIELM (GMM-PIELM), a probabilistic framework that learns a probability density function representing the ``location of physics'' for…
